text: あーあ　まけちゃったわ

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう says the thing happened completely, often to your regret; ちゃった is its casual shortened past form. まけちゃった = 'I went and lost'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way of finishing a sentence. まけちゃったわ = 'oh, I lost'.
